inicio.heroEntradilla: Home cooking from every region of Colombia, right on Broadway. Bring your own bottle — we’ll handle the charcoal.
bandaPiezas: This is what Colombia tastes like
inicio.conceptoTexto: Colombia doesn’t cook the same way on the coast as it does in the mountains. That’s why bandeja paisa, fried red snapper, stuffed potatoes and a 7 a.m. calentado all share this menu. Seventy-four dishes, cooked fresh, the way a family cooks.
inicio.destacadosTexto: Six dishes that sum up the place. Really hungry: bandeja paisa. Coming with friends: the parrillada. Just passing by: empanadas and a fresh pandebono.
inicio.semanaTexto: We rest on Tuesdays. The rest of the week, alongside the full menu, there’s something different waiting.
experienciaLineas: you leave part of the family
inicio.experienciaTexto: The walls were decorated by Colombian artisans. The tables are loud. Whole families come in and we pull the tables together. Nobody rushes you, and if you don’t know what to order, we’ll walk you through it. We’re BYOB — bring your wine or beer, no corkage fee.
inicio.resenasTexto: Don’t take our word for it. Take theirs.
inicio.redesTexto: Photos of the food, the daily specials and whatever is cooking today.
inicio.visitaTexto: Two blocks from St. Luke’s, with plenty of parking right outside. Orders and questions: 610-868-5252.
inicio.byob: BYOB · Bring your wine or beer, no corkage fee
